output.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date)::int AS year, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE is_revenue GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
output.explanation: Revenue is the net revenue of completed orders (is_revenue), excluding shipping fees. It is grouped by calendar year of the order date, which equals the fiscal year. The data covers 2024 and 2025.
